values.name: Arrived
values.description: The means of transport has arrived at a location.

values.name: Authorized to load
values.description: Permission to load has been given by the responsible party.

values.name: Arrived in defective condition
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been received or a means of transport has arrived in a defective condition.

values.name: Defective equipment release
values.description: Equipment previously the subject of a 'defective condition' status has been returned to service.

values.name: Begun
values.description: The process has begun.

values.name: Booked
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment or means of transport have been booked for subsequent movements.

values.name: Booking cancelled
values.description: The booking of goods/consignments/equipment or means of transport previously booked has been cancelled.

values.name: Cleared import restrictions
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment held for import restriction purposes have been released for import.

values.name: Cleared export restrictions
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment held prior to loading have now been cleared for export.

values.name: Cleared by agriculture, food or fisheries authorities
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been held prior to shipment and are now cleared for shipment following examination by relevant authority.

values.name: Cleared by port authority
values.description: The port authority has given permission for the goods/consignments/equipment/means of transport to leave the port.

values.name: Cleared by customs
values.description: Customs have cleared goods/consignments for import/export.

values.name: Collected
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been collected from a predetermined location.

values.name: Completed
values.description: The process has been completed.

values.name: Consolidated
values.description: Goods/consignments have been added to other goods/ consignments to form a larger consignment and/or have been incorporated into one or more containers/units.

values.name: Crossed border
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have crossed a border from one country to another.

values.name: Customs refusal
values.description: The Customs authorities have refused to clear the goods/consignments/equipment.

values.name: Damaged
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been damaged in the course of transportation.

values.name: Damaged equipment quoted
values.description: Damaged equipment has been assessed and the quotation sent to lessor.

values.name: Delayed
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been delayed in the course of transportation.

values.name: Delivered
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been delivered to a location/party in the transport chain.

values.name: Delivery completed
values.description: Delivery of the goods/consignments/equipment has been completed as per instructions.

values.name: Delivery not completed
values.description: Delivery of the goods/consignments/equipment has not been completed in accordance with instructions.

values.name: Departed
values.description: The means of transport has departed from a location in the transport chain.

values.name: Departure delay
values.description: The transport has been delayed in departing on the arranged transport action.

values.name: Deramped
values.description: Equipment has been removed from a position above other equipment on a means of transport.

values.name: Despatched
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have departed from a location in the transport chain.

values.name: Stripped
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been unloaded from equipment in which they were transported.

values.name: Discharged
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been unloaded from a means of transport.

values.name: Empty on inspection
values.description: The package/equipment has been found to be empty.

values.name: En route
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment are in the normal course of transportation to the next destination.

values.name: Equipment in from repair
values.description: A piece of equipment has been received in after having been sent out for repair.

values.name: Equipment out for repair
values.description: A piece of equipment has been sent out for repair.

values.name: Equipment repaired
values.description: A damaged piece of equipment has been repaired.

values.name: Expedited to destination
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been expedited to the next/final destination in the transport chain.

values.name: Not found
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment notified to be missing have not been located.

values.name: Found
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment previously notified missing have now been located.

values.name: Freight paid
values.description: The freight charges on goods/consignments/equipment have been paid.

values.name: From bond
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been moved/are available to be moved from bond.

values.name: Goods/consignments/equipment at port
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have arrived/are available at port.

values.name: Handover
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been formally passed from one point in the transport chain to another under responsibility of the same transporter. (See also 'handover delivered'.)

values.name: Handover delivered
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment from one transport operator have been passed to another transport operator. (see also 'handover'.)

values.name: Handover received
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been received by one transport operator from another transport operator.

values.name: Ill-routed consignment reforwarded
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment which were previously sent to a wrong destination are on the way to correct destination.

values.name: Informed Consignee of arrival
values.description: The consignee has been informed formally of the arrival at a transit or final destination of goods/consignments/equipment.

values.name: Into bond
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been moved/is available to be moved into bond.

values.name: Into packing depot
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been moved into a LCL (less than container load)/packing depot.

values.name: Loaded
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been loaded onto a means of transport.

values.name: Lost
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been lost in the course of a movement along the transport chain.

values.name: Manifested
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been included on the list of units moving from one location to another in the transport chain.

values.name: Means of transport damaged
values.description: The means of transport on which the goods/consignments/equipment was being (was to be) moved has been damaged.

values.name: Mechanical breakdown
values.description: There has been a mechanical breakdown of the means of transport/equipment on which the goods/consignments/equipment was being (was to be) moved.

values.name: No pick-up
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment expected to be picked up and conveyed from location to location in the transport chain have not been picked up.

values.name: Not identified
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment expected to be located and identified in the transport chain cannot be identified.

values.name: Not collected
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment expected to be collected after transportation have not been collected.

values.name: Not delivered
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have not been delivered.

values.name: Not loaded
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment to be loaded onto a means of transport have not been loaded on the expected transport.

values.name: Off hire
values.description: Equipment previously under hire to a customer has been returned to the lessor and the contract has been terminated.

values.name: Off loaded
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment previously loaded to a means of transport have been removed from that means of transport before completion of the planned transport.

values.name: On hire
values.description: Equipment has been hired out to a hirer/customer.

values.name: Outstanding claims settled
values.description: Outstanding claims in respect of goods/consignments/equipment have been settled.

values.name: Over landed
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been discharged from a means of transport at a specific location when they were not expected to be discharged.

values.name: Package not ready
values.description: The package was not available for collection.

values.name: Pick-up awaited
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment are awaiting pick-up.

values.name: Plugged equipment
values.description: Equipment, e.g. a refrigerated container, has been plugged into the power source.

values.name: Plundered
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been plundered.

values.name: Positioned goods/consignments/equipment
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been positioned on a means of transport.

values.name: Pre-informed
values.description: The consignor/consignee has been advised in advance of a transport action.

values.name: Put to refuse
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been written off and disposed of.

values.name: Ramped equipment
values.description: Equipment has been placed above other equipment and placed on a means of transport.

values.name: Ready for transportation
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been made ready for transportation.

values.name: Receipt fully acknowledged
values.description: The consignee has given full acknowledgement for the receipt of goods.

values.name: Receipt partially acknowledged
values.description: The consignee has not given full acknowledgement for the receipt of goods.

values.name: Received
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been received at a location/party in the transport chain.

values.name: Reconsigned
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been consigned to a party other than the original or subsequent consignees.

values.name: Reforwarding on request
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment which have been delayed will be/have been reforwarded on request by appropriate authority.

values.name: Refused without reason given
values.description: The transport action/documentation has been refused without explanation.

values.name: Released
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been released to an authorized party.

values.name: Reloaded
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been reloaded onto a means of transport.

values.name: Returned as instructed
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been returned to a location as per instructions.

values.name: Returned as wreck
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been returned in a wrecked condition to a location as per instructions.

values.name: Returned
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment have been returned to a previous location.

values.name: Sealed equipment
values.description: The equipment has been sealed according to operational and governmental requirements.

values.name: Service ordered
values.description: A service has been ordered in relation to the transportation of goods/consignments/equipment.

values.name: Short landed
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment expected to be discharged from a means of transport at a specific location have not been discharged.

values.name: Short shipped
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment expected to be sent to a specific destination on a selected means of transport from a specific location have not been loaded for onward delivery.

values.name: Sorted wrong route
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been sorted erroneously to an incorrect route.

values.name: Split
values.description: The consignment of goods has been split into two or more consignments.

values.name: Steam cleaned
values.description: The equipment, e.g. a container, has been steam cleaned.

values.name: Stopped
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been stopped from further movement in the transport chain.

values.name: Stored
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been stored at a location.

values.name: Stowed
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been stowed for transportation in the selected equipment/means of transport.

values.name: Stuffed
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been loaded into a piece of equipment, e.g. a container.

values.name: Stuffed and sealed
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been loaded into a piece of equipment and the equipment has been sealed.

values.name: Sub-lease in
values.description: In the leasing of equipment a sub-lease has been notified to the lessor.

values.name: Sub-lease out
values.description: In the leasing of equipment a sub-lease has been notified by a lessee.

values.name: Surveyed damage
values.description: Damaged goods/consignments/equipment have been officially surveyed by a third party to assess the extent of damage.

values.name: Transferred in
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been transferred in from another location.

values.name: Transferred out
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been transferred out to another location.

values.name: Transhipment
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been transhipped to another means of transport.

values.name: Transit delay
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment has been delayed in transit.

values.name: Unknown goods/consignments/equipment
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment are not known to the source being enquired upon.

values.name: Unplugged equipment
values.description: Equipment, e.g. a refrigerated container, has been unplugged from the power source at a given location.
